```{=html}
<style>
.w023 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w023 .w023-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w023 .w023-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w023 .w023-row.w023-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w023 .w023-row.w023-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w023 .w023-st { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w023 .w023-tf {
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); font-weight: 600;
}
.w023 .w023-tf.w023-sel { border-color: #d81e2e; outline: 2px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 1px; }
.w023 .w023-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w023 button.w023-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w023 .w023-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w023 .w023-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w023 .w023-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w023 .w023-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w023 .w023-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w023 iw" id="w023">
  <div class="w023-rows" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w023-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w023-btn w023-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w023-btn w023-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w023-btn w023-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w023-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w023-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w023-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    North–south traffic runs between the data centre and the outside world, east–west between servers inside it, and east–west dominates in the cloud. A tree-shaped network forces that traffic through the links near the root; the leaf–spine design, in which every leaf switch connects to every spine switch, removes the bottleneck, and link aggregation bonds several physical links into one logical link. Because most traffic stays internal, lateral movement is invisible from outside. See <a href="#sec-02-traffic-geography">the section on traffic and geography</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w023');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w023-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w023-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    ['East–west traffic dominates in the cloud.', 't'],
    ['North–south traffic runs between servers inside the data centre.', 'f'],
    ['In a leaf–spine design, every leaf (top-of-rack) switch connects to every spine switch.', 't'],
    ['A tree-shaped network forces east–west traffic through the links near the root, which carry the combined load of everything beneath them.', 't'],
    ['Lateral movement is easy to see from outside the data centre, because most cloud traffic crosses its boundary.', 'f'],
    ['Link aggregation bonds several physical links into one logical link.', 't']
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w023-right', 'w023-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w023-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeRow(text, answer) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w023-row';
    row.dataset.a = answer;
    const st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'w023-st'; st.textContent = text;
    row.appendChild(st);
    ['t', 'f'].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w023-tf'; b.dataset.v = v;
      b.textContent = v === 't' ? 'True' : 'False';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        row.querySelectorAll('.w023-tf').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('w023-sel'));
        b.classList.add('w023-sel');
        clearMarks();
      });
      row.appendChild(b);
    });
    return row;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w023-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w023-right', 'w023-wrong');
      const sel = row.querySelector('.w023-tf.w023-sel');
      if (!sel) { open++; return; }
      if (sel.dataset.v === row.dataset.a) { row.classList.add('w023-right'); right++; }
      else { row.classList.add('w023-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === STATEMENTS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — and where east–west dominates, lateral movement hides.'; msg.className = 'w023-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + open + ' statement(s) not yet judged.'; msg.className = 'w023-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red statements are judged wrongly' + (open ? ', and ' + open + ' still open' : '') + '.'; msg.className = 'w023-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w023-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w023-tf').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w023-sel'));
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w023-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w023-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w023-right', 'w023-wrong');
      row.querySelectorAll('.w023-tf').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('w023-sel', b.dataset.v === row.dataset.a);
      });
      row.classList.add('w023-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w023-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w023-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  STATEMENTS.forEach(s => rowsBox.appendChild(makeRow(s[0], s[1])));
})();
</script>
```
